summary: GPS and radio jamming near Netheravon, Wiltshire, affecting aircraft up to 15,600 ft, 0830 to 1700 daily.
text:
GNSS (GPS L1 AND L2) AND RADIO FREQUENCY JAMMING (868MHZ).
JAMMERS LOCATED PSN 511437N 0014920W (NETHERAVON, WILTSHIRE). 
JAMMING FOCUSSED TO THE NORTH WEST BUT ACTIVITY MAY AFFECT ACFT WI 
2NM SFC TO 15600FT AMSL OR ABOVE (ALL DIRECTIONS). GNSS (GPS)
RECEIVERS MAY SUFFER INTERMITTENT OR TOTAL FAILURE OR MAY PROVIDE
INCORRECT POSITION, NAVIGATION AND TIMING INFORMATION. AIRBORNE
ELECTRONIC SITUATIONAL AWARENESS DEVICES, UAS CONTROL SYSTEMS AND
UAS GNSS RECEIVERS MAY SUFFER INTERMITTENT OR TOTAL FAILURE OR MAY 
PROVIDE INCORRECT POSITION OR ALERTING INFORMATION. FOR INFO/CEASE 
JAMMING 07929 175154/07971 893501.
AR-2026-10784/01.
